name: UNIV 3080
title: Peer Mentor Leadership Development Course
description: Focus on personal growth and leadership development to foster empowerment of self and others through peer mentoring. Students will explore social, cultural, personal, and academic issues that affect first-year students, in particular first-generation college students from underrepresented populations. Some topics covered are empathy, MBTI, effective communications, the transition to college, growth mindset, cultural diversity, and self-awareness. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Open only with consent of instructor, open to sophomores or higher.
